titleEn: Old History of the Five Dynasties
summaryZh: 宋太祖诏薛居正等据五代实录修成，按五朝分书。欧阳修《新五代史》通行后，本书渐亡，清乾隆时从《永乐大典》辑出，再补他书，已非原貌，但仍比新史更近原始档案。
summaryEn: Compiled from Five Dynasties veritable records soon after Song unification. After Ouyang Xiu’s new history became standard, the old one vanished; the Qing reconstructed it from the Yongle Dadian. Even in fragments it is closer to the archives.
notes: 今本为辑本，引用时需注意来源。
十国事迹相对简略，需参《九国志》《十国春秋》等。
